notes: back stays with הֵשִׁבוּ because שׁוּב hiphil is the bringing back and brought alone does not write the returning; rule 44's surplus-particle ruling reaches בּוֹא hiphil, not this verb.

The and between the two juxtaposed imperatives is added, since no conjunction morpheme stands between them (rule 14), and the ye of come ye down is the imperative's own nominative subject pronoun (rule 17).
